inlines.v: ENNO'BLE, verb transitive 1. To make noble; to raise to nobility; as, to ennoble a commoner. 2. To dignify; to exalt; to aggrandize; to elevate in degree, qualities or excellence. What can ennoble sots, or slaves, or cowards? 3. To make famous or illustrious.
